synthesis:draft.headline: Price minimum −504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: A recorded low-price episode in VIC1 on 2026-07-28 covered 2026-07-28T11:15:00Z — 2026-07-28T11:25:00Z and contained 2 five-minute intervals (episode record) (ev0002).
The most extreme five-minute Regional Reference Price was −504.6525 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z (listed as 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (UTC+1000) in the episode record) (ev0001; ev0483).
No five-minute intervals in the window reached the 300.0 $/MWh analysis threshold (intervals at-or-above threshold = 0) (ev0925; ev0926).

Operational demand for the half-hour containing the extreme (half-hour ending 2026-07-28T11:30:00Z / 2026-07-28 21:30 AEST (UTC+1000)) was 7491.0 MW (ev0951); the window maximum reported operational demand = 8131.0 MW (ev0973).

possible_explanations.statement: A surplus of supply relative to demand at the five-minute dispatch interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z may have produced the very low RRP; several large generator SCADA changes are observed in the broader 05:30–17:30 UTC window (ev0978, ev0981, ev0984, ev0987).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check five-minute dispatched MW by DUID and submitted offers for intervals including 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z and the surrounding five-minute intervals (2026-07-28T11:15:00Z and 2026-07-28T11:25:00Z) and compare to the SCADA snapshots (ev0978, ev0981, ev0984, ev0987).

possible_explanations.statement: Net export or import on interconnectors during the interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z might have influenced the regional price (interconnector flow at other times in the window is reported but the 11:20 five-minute NETINTERCHANGE for this interval is not in the retrieved evidence).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve five-minute NETINTERCHANGE for 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z and adjacent five-minute intervals and compare direction/magnitude to the price at 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: Non-conforming or unusual participant behaviour (for example a storage device or bidding pattern) may have contributed; a non-conformance notice for TRGBESS1 on 2026-07-27 is in the retrieved notices [c1], which may be relevant to check but does not itself state a link to the 11:20 interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare participant non-conformance or availability records and bids/offers for TRGBESS1 and other relevant units for 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z; consult the market notices text [c1] and any additional participant notices for that interval.
